items.description: Two photographs interleaved in hard-edged strips that wipe between each other as the pointer crosses the plate.

items.name: reaction-diffusion-plate
items.title: Reaction Diffusion Plate
items.description: A live Gray-Scott solver as a background plate — coral, mitosis and maze are the same two equations at different feed and kill rates.

items.name: ordered-dither-plate
items.title: Ordered Dither Plate
items.description: A gradient quantised to a few tones by an 8x8 Bayer matrix — offset then quantised, dithered in linear light, one cell per device pixel.

items.name: pressure-signature-pad
items.title: Pressure Signature Pad
items.description: A signature pad with real variable-width ink — pen pressure where it exists, velocity everywhere else, coalesced samples and midpoint quadratics.

items.name: median-cut-palette-plate
items.title: Median Cut Palette Plate
items.description: Pulls a genuinely distinct palette out of a photograph by median cut — splitting on channel spread, not on population, sorted by relative luminance.

items.name: verlet-cloth-banner
items.title: Verlet Cloth Banner
items.description: A banner hanging from its fixings as real Verlet cloth — previous-position integration, relaxation passes and a fixed timestep behind an accumulator.

items.name: variable-blur-scrim
items.title: Variable Blur Scrim
items.description: A scrim whose blur ramps instead of switching on — stacked backdrop-filter layers at doubling radii with overlapping masks.

items.name: priority-plus-nav
items.title: Priority Plus Nav
items.description: A nav that measures itself and collapses what does not fit into a More menu — ghost-row measurement, no breakpoints, no flicker loop.

items.name: async-action-button
items.title: Async Action Button
items.description: A button that survives a real round trip — a minimum pending duration, a width that never twitches, aria-disabled instead of disabled.

items.name: iridescent-foil-sweep
items.title: Iridescent Foil Sweep
items.description: Hot-foil type that shifts colour under the pointer — Newton's series rather than a rainbow, translated rather than rotated.

items.name: otp-code-input
items.title: OTP Code Input
items.description: A one-time-code field whose cells survive SMS autofill, paste and Android backspace.

items.name: shortcut-recorder-field
items.title: Shortcut Recorder Field
items.description: Records a keyboard chord by physical key position, and refuses the ones the browser owns.

items.name: selection-annotate-toolbar
items.title: Selection Annotate Toolbar
items.description: A toolbar that follows a text selection and highlights ranges without touching the DOM.

items.name: concrete-wall-texture
items.title: Concrete Wall Texture
items.description: A seamless procedural concrete surface drawn once to canvas and blended over anything.

items.name: knockout-type-plate
items.title: Knockout Type Plate
items.description: A headline that inverts the photograph beneath it, with a scrim that keeps it legible.

items.name: live-hours-nav
items.title: Live Hours Nav
items.description: A small-business header that says whether the shop is open right now — computed in the shop's timezone, with overnight hours and split shifts handled.

items.name: entry-edge-fill-button
items.title: Entry Edge Fill Button
items.description: A fill that wipes in from the edge your pointer crossed and leaves by the one you exit — the label inverts letter by letter as the edge passes through it.

items.name: index-overlay-menu
items.title: Index Overlay Menu
items.description: A full-screen menu set like a printed index — numbered entries in heavy type, and a treated photo plate that wipes in the direction you travel.

items.name: ripple-roll-button
items.title: Ripple Roll Button
items.description: A label that rolls letter by letter to a second copy, rippling outward from wherever your pointer came in — and settling back toward where it left.

items.name: chapter-progress-nav
items.title: Chapter Progress Nav
items.description: A sticky section nav whose items fill like progress bars as you read — and still reaches the short last section that fixed-line navs never activate.

items.name: letterpress-light-type
items.title: Letterpress Light Type
items.description: Type debossed into paper and lit by a real lighting model — the lamp follows your pointer, so every wall of every letter catches and loses the light.

items.name: venetian-blind-slideshow
items.title: Venetian Blind Slideshow
items.description: A hero slideshow whose photographs change like venetian blinds turning — slats flip in a staggered cascade, with the dark frame showing through as they go edge-on.

items.name: ink-bleed-reveal
items.title: Ink Bleed Reveal
items.description: A photograph that arrives the way ink wicks into paper — an organic front spreading from a point, with a wet tide-line of ink running just ahead of it.

items.name: thumb-action-dock
items.title: Thumb Action Dock
items.description: A phone bottom bar with Call, Directions and Book — that appears once the hero's CTA has gone, and steps aside for the footer, a focused field and the keyboard.

items.name: neon-tube-sign
items.title: Neon Tube Sign
items.description: A neon sign that lights the wall behind it — glass tubes with a hot core, one tired letter that stutters, an ignition flicker, and a real on/off switch.

items.name: booking-slot-picker
items.title: Booking Slot Picker
items.description: Pick a day, pick a time, confirm — with honest availability, a real keyboard grid, and a WhatsApp or email request mode for shops with no booking system.

items.name: service-price-ledger
items.title: Service Price Ledger
items.description: A price list set like a printed menu — baseline dot leaders, tabular prices, a Book link per row — beside a photo plate that follows hover, focus, or on phones the row mid-screen.

items.name: find-us-map-section
items.title: Find Us Map Section
items.description: A street map printed in the shop's colour, the address set large, a live "Open until 18:00" readout in the shop's own time, the week's hours, nearby stations and one-tap directions — no API key.

items.name: aperture-iris-reveal
items.title: Aperture Iris Reveal
items.description: A photo revealed by a real iris — straight metal blades that part and twist from the centre — while a corner readout clicks down the f-stops from ƒ/22 to ƒ/1.4.

items.name: rotating-seal-badge
items.title: Rotating Seal Badge
items.description: A round seal — the phrase fitted exactly around the circle with drawn dot separators — that turns once every 24 seconds, eases to a stop on hover, and is the link.

items.name: signal-field
items.title: Signal Field
items.description: A machined dot grid lit by slow waves of light, with a pointer lens and click ripples.

items.name: marker-highlight-text
items.title: Marker Highlight Text
items.description: A felt-tip highlighter stroke with a ragged edge that draws itself behind a phrase when it scrolls into view.

items.name: window-light-drift
items.title: Window Light Drift
items.description: Afternoon sun through a window, crossing a plaster wall over ninety seconds — and your pointer casts a shadow in it.

items.name: swatch-fan-deck
items.title: Swatch Fan Deck
items.description: A fan deck of paint chips that spreads in your hand on hover or focus — a real radio group, with arrow keys and the colour's name, not its hex.

items.name: hours-poster-section
items.title: Hours Poster Section
items.description: Opening hours set as a poster — days hanging off the edge, closed rows struck through, today banded in the one accent — with an open/closed line on the shop's clock.

items.name: headline-switch-hero
items.title: Headline Switch Hero
items.description: The second line of the headline is the navigation: KITCHENS / BATHROOMS / LOFTS at headline size, and choosing one swaps the treated photo plate, the copy and the price.

items.name: seam-reveal-hero
items.title: Seam Reveal Hero
items.description: A before-and-after hero with no handle: the seam is wherever your pointer is, eased like a curtain, and the colour arrives with the work.

items.name: class-timetable-section
items.title: Class Timetable Section
items.description: A week of classes set like a departure board — placed by real start time and length, one accent stripe behind today, filters that dim rather than delete, and a day rail on phones.

items.name: gift-voucher-composer
items.title: Gift Voucher Composer
items.description: Pick an amount, write a line, and the voucher is on the table as you type — a perforated bond-paper ticket with the amount cropped by its own edge and a serial that never changes under you.

items.name: colourway-product-card
items.title: Colourway Product Card
items.description: One photograph, every colourway: the shot is greyscaled and multiplied into the chosen colour, so a small label with six colours and one product photo gets six product photos.

items.name: curtain-footer-section
items.title: Curtain Footer Section
items.description: The page ends, lifts, and the footer is already there underneath: a sticky footer revealed by the last section sliding over it, with the wordmark cropped by the bottom edge. No JavaScript in the reveal.

items.name: ink-fluid-field
items.title: Ink Fluid Field
items.description: A real Navier–Stokes fluid simulation on the GPU: your pointer drags luminous ink through dark water, and slow currents keep it alive when nobody is touching it.

items.name: prism-beam-hero
items.title: Prism Beam Hero
items.description: A raymarched glass prism on black: a white beam comes in from wherever your pointer is, a spectrum fans out the other side, and the prism turns once a minute. One shader, no libraries.

items.name: lathe-story-scroll
items.title: Lathe Story Scroll
items.description: A five-chapter scroll story that turns a single drawn line into a three-dimensional object: revolved, glazed, exploded into named parts and reassembled, with no three.js.

items.name: marbled-endpaper
items.title: Marbled Endpaper
items.description: Paper marbling computed live on a canvas: two inks on unbleached paper, combed slowly into veins, with the pointer as the stylus and one accent drop the reader places by clicking.

items.name: final-call-section
items.title: Final Call Section
items.description: The closing spread of a trade site: an oversized two-tier ask cropped by the edge, a two-field enquiry line with one filled button, and a ledger of the four things customers ring to check.

items.name: liquid-glass-button
items.title: Liquid Glass Button
items.description: A pill of liquid glass that bends what is behind it: real refraction at the rim, a rim and sheen lit by your pointer, and a gel-like press.

items.name: liquid-glass-switch
items.title: Liquid Glass Switch
items.description: A toggle whose knob swells into a clear glass lens while you hold or drag it, magnifying the track beneath, then springs home solid.

items.name: liquid-glass-tab-bar
items.title: Liquid Glass Tab Bar
items.description: A floating glass tab bar whose selection is a droplet: press and drag and it swells, stretches as it travels, magnifies the tabs beneath and lands on the nearest one.

items.name: liquid-lens-hero
items.title: Liquid Lens Hero
items.description: A slab of liquid glass you drag across a vivid scene: the headline bends under its rim, colours split at the edge, and it wobbles like gel. Two WebGL passes, no libraries.

items.name: glass-bento-wall
items.title: Glass Bento Wall
items.description: A feature grid cut from one sheet of liquid glass: each tile is as thick as it is big, and one pointer light moves across every rim.

items.name: liquid-wallpaper-field
items.title: Liquid Wallpaper Field
items.description: A slow WebGL wallpaper of folded silk layers on a seamless 60-second loop: vivid, calm, and sharp-edged enough for glass to bend.

items.name: glass-etch-text
items.title: Glass Etch Text
items.description: Real, selectable heading text rendered as glass: a lit bevel, a graduated rim and a hairline colour fringe, raised or etched in.

items.name: glass-focus-field
items.title: Glass Focus Field
items.description: A liquid-glass input whose rim notices the pointer before focus, thickens outward from where you click, ripples from the caret with every keystroke and clouds its frost on an error.

items.name: glass-pricing-tiers
items.title: Glass Pricing Tiers
items.description: A pricing section where each plan is a thicker pane of glass than the last, and the plan you choose puts a lens over its price.

items.name: glass-app-template
items.title: Glass App Template
items.description: A complete liquid-glass product page for a calendar app, where every glass surface shares one tint that adapts to the section under the nav as you scroll.

items.name: glass-morph-popover
items.title: Glass Morph Popover
items.description: A popover that grows out of its button as a drop of liquid glass, stretches toward its place and settles flat, then drains back the same way.

items.name: glass-tint-footer
items.title: Glass Tint Footer
items.description: A liquid-glass footer slab that rises over the section above as you scroll in, its meniscus edge sloshing on fast scrolls, with a pointer light, a droplet gliding between links and frost re-tinted to that section.

items.name: hairline-tile-button
items.title: Hairline Tile Button
items.description: A button that behaves like a live bento grid: on hover it re-tiles into compartments along lit hairline seams, compresses toward your press, and its keycaps are a real keyboard shortcut.

items.name: spec-numeral-tile
items.title: Spec Numeral Tile
items.description: A big bold numeral in a spec-sheet voice whose digits roll into place like an odometer, set in a hairline bento tile.

items.name: living-bento-grid
items.title: Living Bento Grid
items.description: A dark bento feature grid that is a live system: tiles update on their own, catch a pointer light, reorder by drag or keyboard, and grow into a detail panel.

items.name: keynote-bento-hero
items.title: Keynote Bento Hero
items.description: A launch hero set like a keynote recap slide: one huge figure in a 2x2 tile, and a bento grid that assembles around it as the numbers count up.

items.name: tile-expand-panel
items.title: Tile Expand Panel
items.description: A primitive that grows any bento tile into a full panel: the panel opens from the tile's own rectangle while its cover, title and figure fly across to their new places.

items.name: bento-pricing-tiles
items.title: Bento Pricing Tiles
items.description: Pricing set as a bento grid: the recommended plan is the one 2x2 tile with the biggest price and the only accent, surrounded by plans, reassurances and a sales tile.

items.name: bento-command-nav
items.title: Bento Command Nav
items.description: Site navigation as one row of bento tiles sharing 1px hairlines, with a pointer light that shows through them and menus that open as panels of tiles.

items.name: capture-loop-card
items.title: Capture Loop Card
items.description: A bento tile whose picture is a tightly cropped loop of your product, still until someone hovers or presses play, with a hairline that tracks the loop.

items.name: metric-proof-tiles
items.title: Metric Proof Tiles
items.description: A proof section set as bento tiles: 1x1 figures that count up once as they arrive, one accent tile that breaks the row, a quote, and a live figure that ticks slowly.

items.name: bento-footer-grid
items.title: Bento Footer Grid
items.description: A bento footer whose tiles are live: a 90-day uptime strip you can read day by day, a back-to-top ring that fills as you scroll, a newsletter that widens across its row as its neighbours reflow, and a wordmark that rises into its crop.

items.name: widget-reorder-input
items.title: Widget Reorder Input
items.description: A "customise your dashboard" panel: drag or keyboard reorder, show and hide switches, a live miniature of the result, and save, cancel and reset.

items.name: bento-launch-template
items.title: Bento Launch Template
items.description: A complete launch page from the Bento Box kit: keynote figures, product captures, proof, pricing and a footer set as tiles, broken once by a full-bleed race between two builds.

items.name: slab-stack-hero
items.title: Slab Stack Hero
items.description: A neo-brutalist first screen: a slab headline beside a pile of hard-shadow cards you can grab and throw. Thrown cards fly off and cut to the bottom; the rest step up. Nothing eases.

items.name: card-shuffle-deck
items.title: Card Shuffle Deck
items.description: A reorderable neo-brutalist deck where cards lift onto their shadows, travel in straight lines and land exactly. Drag, shuffle or move with the keyboard; ranks stamp as cards land.

items.name: pushed-shadow-button
items.title: Pushed Shadow Button
items.description: A neo-brutalist button on a hard 5px shadow: hover lifts it 2px, a press lands it exactly on its shadow. 3px ink everywhere, 100ms linear, no blur.

items.name: offset-shadow-card
items.title: Offset Shadow Card
items.description: A neo-brutalist card on a hard shadow: it lifts 2px on hover and lands on the shadow when pressed. A flat drawn motif or a photo, a punched price tag, a sticker badge, 3px ink throughout.

items.name: stamped-feature-grid
items.title: Stamped Feature Grid
items.description: Features in an exposed table with A1 coordinates. As each row scrolls in, its cells are stamped on left to right: a black slab wipes across in hard steps, then the cell prints.

items.name: brutal-mega-menu
items.title: Brutal Mega Menu
items.description: A neo-brutalist bar whose menu is a full-screen index that cuts in and out in one frame: huge section rows between 3px rules, a hard inverted selection, links and a feature card beside it.

items.name: weight-slam-text
items.title: Weight Slam Text
items.description: Display type whose weight slams instead of easing: letters jump 400 → 650 → 900 in two hard steps, left to right like a row of stamps, and let go in three.

items.name: black-border-form
items.title: Black Border Form
items.description: Neo-brutalist form fields in 3px ink: focus presses a field into its shadow, and errors are stamped on as tilted black tags. The browser's own validation, a posting form and a received stamp.

items.name: neo-brutal-saas-template
items.title: Neo-Brutal SaaS Template
items.description: A complete neo-brutalist landing page for a software product: a throwable card-pile hero, stamped feature table, customer quotes, punched changelog ledger, sticker pricing, FAQ and a hazard-tape footer.

items.name: sticker-pricing-section
items.title: Sticker Pricing Section
items.description: Neo-brutalist pricing where each price is a label stuck on its card at a tilt. A monthly or yearly switch changes every price in one frame; the featured plan sits higher on a deeper shadow.

items.name: punch-card-field
items.title: Punch Card Field
items.description: A background of 80-column punch cards whose holes spell real text in Hollerith code. Holes are punched in column by column on arrival; point at a column to decode it.

items.name: warning-tape-footer
items.title: Warning Tape Footer
items.description: A neo-brutalist footer under a strip of hazard tape you can grab and throw on its slow 48-second crawl, a sign-up that stamps the tape, and a giant wordmark whose letters press down onto their own ink plates.

items.name: beam-lattice-hero
items.title: Beam Lattice Hero
items.description: A first screen on a lattice of hairline traces where pulses of light run in from the edges and converge on the call to action, the traces light up under the pointer, and the headline is revealed by a scanning light.

items.name: lit-dot-matrix-field
items.title: Lit Dot Matrix Field
items.description: A WebGL dot matrix under one volumetric light cone that leans toward the pointer: dots inside the light rise in brightness and size and take on the accent.

items.name: orbit-light-button
items.title: Orbit Light Button
items.description: A dark pill whose border carries one light: it laps the outline slowly, glides to the nearest point of the border under the pointer and lights the surface from there, and a press sends a ring outward.

items.name: pointer-lit-card
items.title: Pointer Lit Card
items.description: A card lit from the pointer: a bright arc of light on the hairline border, a softer wash across the surface, a two-degree tilt toward the pointer and a little counter-parallax on the content.

items.name: morphing-command-nav
items.title: Morphing Command Nav
items.description: A floating nav pill that grows into a command palette in place: the same surface morphs from pill to panel, results are grouped with a light that slides between them, and it shrinks back on Escape or a pick.

items.name: slit-light-heading
items.title: Slit Light Heading
items.description: A heading lit by a narrow slit of light that crosses it as it scrolls into view: letters under the slit burn white, letters it has passed stay lit, letters ahead wait in the dark.

items.name: circuit-feature-map
items.title: Circuit Feature Map
items.description: Features as nodes on a hairline circuit around a core chip: traces draw in on scroll, pulses run out of the core to each node, and hovering a node lights its trace, its pin and the core.

items.name: deploy-log-input
items.title: Deploy Log Input
items.description: An email field that answers with a streaming log: on submit, short lines stream under it with spinners turning into checks while a beam of light runs along its top edge, and the last line waits for your handler.

items.name: fit-light-pricing
items.title: Fit Light Pricing
items.description: Pricing driven by a usage slider on a log scale: every price rolls to its new digits as you drag, and a light moves to the plan that costs least at that volume, its arc growing as usage nears the next plan.

items.name: horizon-light-footer
items.title: Horizon Light Footer
items.description: A footer whose giant wordmark is lit from below by a horizon that is also a signal: a latency trace lit where the pointer is, with a request pulse that runs it every few seconds and lights the letters as it passes.

items.name: beam-connector
items.title: Beam Connector
items.description: A hairline beam between any two elements, routed with rounded right-angle elbows, that carries a pulse of light once per cycle and lands with a flash at the far end.

items.name: dark-precision-site
items.title: Dark Precision Site
items.description: A complete launch site for a developer platform in the Linear/Vercel register: a nav that morphs into a command palette, a hero on a routing lattice of light, a trace console, beams that deliver, a circuit of features, pricing lit by a usage slider, a WebGL light-cone call to action and a horizon-lit footer.

items.name: molten-chrome-hero
items.title: Molten Chrome Hero
items.description: A first screen whose title is molten chrome in WebGL: the lit room it reflects turns with the pointer, the metal swells toward it, fast moves and clicks send ripples through the letters, and it stands on a mirror floor.

items.name: holo-foil-field
items.title: Holo Foil Field
items.description: A full-bleed sheet of holographic chrome in WebGL: long draped folds reflect the kit's studio, every seam the horizon draws splits into a spectrum, and a thin film tints only the lit metal; tilting it with the pointer sweeps the colour.

items.name: chrome-pill-button
items.title: Chrome Pill Button
items.description: A pill of polished chrome that reflects a lit room: its horizon, softbox glint and bezel light turn toward the pointer, and a press squashes it and drops a ring into the surface.

items.name: holo-ticket-card
items.title: Holo Ticket Card
items.description: A tour date as a notched, perforated ticket whose stub carries the date in chrome numerals on a strip of holographic foil; it tilts toward the pointer while the foil's colour slides and a glare follows.

items.name: pour-tracklist-section
items.title: Pour Tracklist Section
items.description: An album tracklist where each row is its own progress bar: liquid chrome pours across the row as the preview plays, the labels under the metal turn dark, and you scrub by dragging the row.

items.name: mirror-pool-footer
items.title: Mirror Pool Footer
items.description: A footer whose giant chrome wordmark stands on the waterline of a dark pool that mirrors it: a real wave simulation rings under the pointer and takes a drop every ten seconds, bending the reflection as it ripples.

items.name: pour-fill-heading
items.title: Pour Fill Heading
items.description: A heading that starts as an empty mould and fills with liquid chrome as it scrolls into view, its surface a meniscus with a hot line of light that sloshes with scroll speed and settles.

items.name: chrome-rim-input
items.title: Chrome Rim Input
items.description: An email field in a pill with a chrome rim: each keystroke sends two ripples of light racing round the rim from the caret, a light laps it while sending, and success pours the pill into a round chrome drop with a check.

items.name: chrome-vinyl-preorder
items.title: Chrome Vinyl Preorder
items.description: A vinyl pre-order you can play with: flick the canvas record and it spins with inertia under a sheen that stays with the light, the chrome tonearm swings on when it spins fast, and the pressings sit beside it as a radio group.

items.name: mercury-pour-nav
items.title: Mercury Pour Nav
items.description: A floating nav whose current-link indicator is a capsule of mercury on two springs: it stretches thin as it pours to the next link, snaps back round, reaches toward the link you hover, and turns the labels it covers dark.

items.name: chrome-pour-reveal
items.title: Chrome Pour Reveal
items.description: A reveal that casts its content in liquid chrome: molten metal pours down over the space with drips racing ahead and merging into the sheet, then cools away from the top behind a hot seam of light.

items.name: liquid-chrome-site
items.title: Liquid Chrome Site
items.description: A complete album and tour drop for a recording artist in molten chrome: a mercury nav, a WebGL chrome title on a mirror floor, a pour-to-play tracklist, a holographic foil statement, tour tickets cast in chrome, a spinnable vinyl pre-order, a rippling pre-save field and a pool footer.

items.name: breathing-halo-hero
items.title: Breathing Halo Hero
items.description: A first screen in a near-black jade room lit by two soft, grained halos in WebGL: the lead one breathes on a slow cycle and leans toward the pointer with a 900ms settle, and the serif headline warms where the light sits behind it.

items.name: halo-mesh-field
items.title: Halo Mesh Field
items.description: A quiet WebGL field for the body of a page: two grained pools of colour drift across warm bone like light through tinted glass, and a warm lamp gathers under the pointer where you rest.

items.name: soft-glow-button
items.title: Soft Glow Button
items.description: A pill with a grained light inside it that follows the pointer with a slow settle, a diffused bloom that rises behind it, and a press that exhales a soft ring of light.

items.name: halo-treatment-card
items.title: Halo Treatment Card
items.description: A treatment card with a light well: a grained halo in the treatment's own colour rests low, then rises and blooms toward the pointer on hover or focus while the card lifts on a feathered shadow.

items.name: concern-finder-section
items.title: Concern Finder Section
items.description: A three-question treatment finder: pick a concern, sensitivity and downtime, and the treatments that fit rise into the light, each as bright as its fit, gliding to new ranks as answers change.

items.name: halo-concern-nav
items.title: Halo Concern Nav
items.description: A floating nav in warm day glass whose Treatments menu opens by skin concern: a soft halo glides behind the concern you point at or arrow to, and its treatments resolve out of a blur beside it.

items.name: veil-resolve-heading
items.title: Veil Resolve Heading
items.description: A serif heading that arrives out of soft light: each word condenses from a blur into focus with an 80ms stagger while a glow blooms behind the words and fades as they sharpen.

items.name: aura-booking-picker
items.title: Aura Booking Picker
items.description: A booking picker in three quiet steps, treatment, day and time, where the chosen time blooms into a grained halo, and a request that needs your handler before it confirms anything.

items.name: lit-rooms-membership
items.title: Lit Rooms Membership
items.description: Memberships as three rooms along a corridor, each with its own grained lamp: point at one and its light rises while the others dim, and the billing switch resolves every price out of a blur.

items.name: dusk-set-footer
items.title: Dusk Set Footer
items.description: A footer that sets like the sun: as it scrolls in, a grained halo sinks toward a hairline horizon, warming from gold through rose to ember, behind a giant italic serif wordmark.

items.name: breath-pacer-ring
items.title: Breath Pacer Ring
items.description: A breathing guide in soft light: a grained halo swells as you breathe in and settles as you breathe out, a thin ring traces each phase and the seconds count down; it starts only when asked.

items.name: diffused-glow-site
items.title: Diffused Glow Site
items.description: A complete site for a modern skin clinic and day spa: a concern-organised nav, a jade room lit by breathing WebGL halos, a treatment finder, treatment cards with light wells, lit-room memberships, a breathing ritual, a booking picker and a footer at dusk.

items.name: aurora-horizon-hero
items.title: Aurora Horizon Hero
items.description: A first screen at night under real aurora in WebGL: curtains fold, ray and drift over a sleeping city and bow toward the pointer, and the headline sits on frosted glass tinted by the live sky.

items.name: aurora-curtain-field
items.title: Aurora Curtain Field
items.description: The kit's aurora on its own, in WebGL: three curtains with bright borders, fraying rays and folds over a field of stars, bowing toward the pointer, for any dark section.

items.name: aurora-glow-button
items.title: Aurora Glow Button
items.description: A night-glass pill with a sliver of aurora under it, turning on a 60s clock that every button on the page shares, spreading on hover and sending a ring of light out on press.

items.name: aurora-rim-card
items.title: Aurora Rim Card
items.description: A night-glass card with a slow aurora rim that turns once every 52 seconds, feathered into light, brightening near the pointer while the card tilts a hair toward it.

items.name: aurora-window-features
items.title: Aurora Window Features
items.description: Feature cards as windows onto one sky: a single WebGL canvas draws the aurora only inside each card's window, so a curtain carries on from one window to the next.

items.name: aurora-rise-footer
items.title: Aurora Rise Footer
items.description: A footer where the lights come out as the page ends: scroll raises the aurora from behind the city's roofline, widens it into violet and rose and lights more windows under a large lit wordmark.

items.name: aurora-drift-text
items.title: Aurora Drift Text
items.description: Display type filled with aurora light: three bands drift through the letters on slow loops, ray threads slide through them, and the brightest band leans toward the pointer when it comes near.

items.name: aurora-flow-nav
items.title: Aurora Flow Nav
items.description: A floating night-glass nav whose active mark is a band of aurora light that takes the colour of the sky above its link and flows to the next one leading edge first.

items.name: aurora-volume-pricing
items.title: Aurora Volume Pricing
items.description: Usage pricing where the sky answers the number: a log-scale slider rolls the price digit by digit while the aurora behind widens from a dim, cool display to the whole palette and the city lights up.

items.name: aurora-ribbon-cursor
items.title: Aurora Ribbon Cursor
items.description: The pointer paints a small aurora: a ribbon of light coloured from the indigo fringe to rose that fades like the sky, sending short rays up from every point so the trail reads as a curtain.

items.name: aurora-glow-input
items.title: Aurora Glow Input
items.description: A waitlist field that lights like the sky: focus raises a two-hue bloom and lights the rim, every keystroke sends a rose ripple from the caret, and joining sweeps the whole palette once.

items.name: aurora-site
items.title: Aurora Site
items.description: A complete launch site for an overnight AI finance agent in the Aurora register: a flowing aurora nav, a WebGL hero over a sleeping city, window features, pricing that lights the sky and a footer where the lights come out.

items.name: flush-pressure-hero
items.title: Flush Pressure Hero
items.description: A first screen set as a type poster: the name in flush lines at one cap height, and the pointer presses weight, width and contrast into the letters near it while the rest condense so every line stays flush.

items.name: glyph-wave-field
items.title: Glyph Wave Field
items.description: A field of letters on canvas that behaves like water: drag the pointer and a wake of weight follows, tap and rings travel out, crests swelling to 900 in the accent and troughs thinning to hairlines.

items.name: axis-press-button
items.title: Axis Press Button
items.description: A button whose label is the control: letters under the pointer swell heavier and wider while the rest condense, so the button never changes size, and a press clenches every letter and springs it back.

items.name: axis-session-card
items.title: Axis Session Card
items.description: A programme card whose title is set by what the session is: a workshop quiet and narrow, a talk set, a keynote loud and wide, so a grid reads as a legend; hover pushes it further into its own kind.

items.name: flush-lineup-poster
items.title: Flush Lineup Poster
items.description: A line-up set as a type poster: every name flush across the measure at one cap height, pointing clenches a name into the accent, choosing opens it, and day filters collapse the rest to hairlines.

items.name: flush-wordmark-footer
items.title: Flush Wordmark Footer
items.description: A footer that ends the page in the face: a band of the glyph wave field carries a closing line, and the name stands flush across the width, rising from hairlines to full weight as the footer comes into view.

items.name: axis-scrub-heading
items.title: Axis Scrub Heading
items.description: A heading written by the scroll: as it rises through the view a wave runs through its letters from hairline to a loud accent peak to its set weight, and scrolling back unwrites it.

items.name: axis-flow-nav
items.title: Axis Flow Nav
items.description: A nav whose links are one flush line: the active link is loud, the rest condensed, and choosing another makes the width flow to it letter by letter while the nav never changes size.

items.name: axis-pass-pricing
items.title: Axis Pass Pricing
items.description: Passes as tickets named in their own registers, quiet to loud: choose a pass, the count or the student rate and every figure that changes rebuilds digit by digit through the accent.

items.name: glyph-axis-stagger
items.title: Glyph Axis Stagger
items.description: The kit's rebuild as a primitive: split any text into letters and spring each one between two settings of the face, a fixed delay apart, in the order you choose, on view, on hover or on command.

items.name: name-badge-input
items.title: Name Badge Input
items.description: A name field that sets your name on a pass as you type: each new letter lands loud in the accent and springs into place, a deleted one collapses to a hairline, and the name stays flush across the badge.

items.name: kinetic-type-site
items.title: Kinetic Type Site
items.description: The whole Kinetic Type kit as one festival site: a flush nav, a pressure poster hero, a glyph wave field, a scrolled manifesto, the programme, a flush line-up, rebuilding passes, a name badge and a rising footer.

items.name: orbit-product-hero
items.title: Orbit Product Hero
items.description: A first screen with the product in it, raymarched live in WebGL2: drag the dial round, move across the hero to click its ring through detents, and switch its finish between titanium, ceramic and polymer.

items.name: soft-form-field
items.title: Soft Form Field
items.description: A background of soft forms raymarched live in WebGL2: rounded cubes, capsules and rings in ceramic, titanium and polymer drift, melt into one another where they meet and part around the pointer.

items.name: keycap-button
items.title: Keycap Button
items.description: A button machined like a keycap: a press drops the cap 6px as its skirt collapses, release springs it back past rest, a specular follows the pointer and a copper status light glows while it's held.

items.name: extruded-spec-card
items.title: Extruded Spec Card
items.description: A card holding a small machined dial built in CSS 3D: the card tilts toward the pointer and the dial turns to follow it one detent at a time, its copper marker lit, over a data-plate of specs.

items.name: exploded-view-section
items.title: Exploded View Section
items.description: The product taken apart live in WebGL2: its parts separate on a spring and each carries a callout pinned to it by a leader line re-projected from the 3D scene every frame, so labels stay on their part as it turns.

items.name: pedestal-footer
items.title: Pedestal Footer
items.description: A footer where the product comes to rest: as it scrolls into view the dial floats down onto a mirror floor, its parts closing up as it lands, over a large wordmark lit from the object's key light.

items.name: anamorphic-heading
items.title: Anamorphic Heading
items.description: A heading that only reads from the right angle: its letters stand at different depths, scaled so they line up from straight ahead, and the view swings round to square as it scrolls in.

items.name: curved-rail-nav
items.title: Curved Rail Nav
items.description: A nav whose links ride a shallow cylinder in real perspective: the active link stands forward and underlit in copper, and choosing another turns the rail toward it on a spring.

items.name: finish-tier-pricing
items.title: Finish Tier Pricing
items.description: Pricing where each tier is a material shown on the product itself: the dial stands on a mirror floor in the chosen finish, changes material when you pick another tier, hops and clicks its ring round.

items.name: assemble-reveal
items.title: Assemble Reveal
items.description: A reveal where parts assemble in 3D: each item starts at its own offset and turn deep in perspective and flies home on a spring with a slight overshoot, one after another, as it comes into view.

items.name: detent-dial-input
items.title: Detent Dial Input
items.description: A number set by turning a CSS-3D dial: drag round it and it steps through detents, springing onto each while its copper marker ticks; a real slider with full keyboard control that submits in a form.

items.name: spatial-3d-site
items.title: Spatial 3D Site
items.description: The whole Spatial 3D kit as one hardware launch: a curved rail nav, the product live in the hero, a field of soft forms, the product taken apart, profile cards, pricing by material, a dial input and a pedestal footer.

items.name: transform-loupe-hero
items.title: Transform Loupe Hero
items.description: A first screen whose picture is computed live: a plane of spheres under a low sun, printed in blue-noise dither, with a loupe under the pointer that shows it as shape-matched ASCII, a halftone screen, Bayer or the source.

items.name: ascii-flow-field
items.title: ASCII Flow Field
items.description: A background of live ASCII: a drifting contour map set glyph by glyph in your mono face, matched to the shape of each cell, that bends round a hill the pointer raises, its upper contours in signal.

items.name: bayer-fill-button
items.title: Bayer Fill Button
items.description: A button whose fill prints in cell by cell through the 8x8 Bayer order on hover and focus, with its label inverting exactly where each cell lands; press it and the screen halves to a finer grid.

items.name: dither-develop-card
items.title: Dither Develop Card
items.description: A card whose image prints in cell by cell the first time it is seen, ordered-dithered with CSS alone, with a soft light that follows the pointer through the dither.

items.name: transform-compare-section
items.title: Transform Compare Section
items.description: One source through every transform, split by a wipe you drag: a raymarched still life on the left, and on the right true Atkinson or Floyd–Steinberg diffusion, blue noise, Bayer, halftone or shape-matched ASCII.

items.name: ascii-wordmark-footer
items.title: ASCII Wordmark Footer
items.description: A footer whose name is set in live ASCII: the wordmark drawn glyph by glyph in signal, printed in cell by cell as the footer rises, crossed by a slow light, and turned to paper under the pointer.

items.name: ascii-resolve-heading
items.title: ASCII Resolve Heading
items.description: A heading that resolves from ASCII into type: its own letterforms redrawn in shape-matched glyphs step from coarse to fine as it comes into view, then a lens under the pointer shows the glyphs again.

items.name: ascii-density-nav
items.title: ASCII Density Nav
items.description: A nav whose active link is marked by a band of ASCII density: characters thicken through a ramp under the active link and flow to the next one on a spring, its peak in signal.

items.name: noise-fill-pricing
items.title: Noise Fill Pricing
items.description: Pricing where volume fills a plane of dots in blue-noise order: drag the images a month and the dots light evenly with no clumps, the newly lit ones flashing signal, while the plan that covers it lights up.

items.name: dither-ascii-site
items.title: Dither & ASCII Site
items.description: The whole Dither & ASCII kit as one site for an image pipeline: a density nav, a live dithered hero with a transform loupe, an ASCII field, a transform comparison, printing cards, a drop-to-dither form, noise-fill pricing and an ASCII wordmark footer.

items.name: bayer-dissolve
items.title: Bayer Dissolve
items.description: An ordered-dither transition: a new state prints in over the old one in 8x8 Bayer order while the screen refines from coarse cells to fine, or prints in from the ground on first view.

items.name: dither-drop-input
items.title: Dither Drop Input
items.description: Drop an image and see it dithered right there, with CSS alone: choose the cell size and the ink, set the exposure, and the request URL for that output builds as you go; submitting copies it.

items.name: dawn-scrub-hero
items.title: Dawn Scrub Hero
items.description: A first screen that is night until you scroll it into morning: the hero pins and the scroll is the dawn, bound with no easing, as a live-rendered room goes from dark to paper white and the lamp from ember to daylight.

items.name: morning-light-field
items.title: Morning Light Field
items.description: A background of morning light through a window, on paper: six panes of warm light fall across the wall with leaves moving slowly in them, rendered live, and the pointer turns the sun a little.

items.name: weight-press-button
items.title: Weight Press Button
items.description: A button whose press you can see in its type: hover and the label thickens as the button lifts; press and it goes bold under your finger while the button sinks and its shadow collapses to the contact line, then springs back.

items.name: light-lift-card
items.title: Light Lift Card
items.description: A card that lifts toward the pointer with shadows that behave like light: a two-degree tilt, an ambient shadow that widens and drifts away from the side that rose, a contact line that thins, and a plate of light at a colour temperature.

items.name: dawn-timeline-section
items.title: Dawn Timeline Section
items.description: The sunrise laid out on a timeline and scrubbed by the scroll: the section pins, 05:30 to 07:00 runs with the scroll, the lamp rendered live rises along its curve, and the time, colour, output and phase follow.

items.name: ember-rest-footer
items.title: Ember Rest Footer
items.description: A footer where the day ends: as it rises into view the room above the links, rendered live, loses its daylight, the lamp dims to an ember, and the whole footer goes from paper to night under a closing line.

items.name: sundial-shadow-heading
items.title: Sundial Shadow Heading
items.description: A heading whose letters cast soft shadows that swing like a sundial as the page scrolls: the sun crosses with the scroll, the long shadows turn from right to left, and a faint warm band of light slides across the ink.

items.name: hairline-morph-nav
items.title: Hairline Morph Nav
items.description: A nav whose single hairline stretches toward the next link and settles under it: its leading edge runs ahead on a quick spring while its trailing edge follows on a slower one, and the active label steps up a weight without shifting.

items.name: program-curve-pricing
items.title: Program Curve Pricing
items.description: Pricing beside the product's sunrise programs: pick gentle, standard or brisk and its curve morphs on a spring while the lamp, rendered live in a dark room, plays that sunrise in six seconds, next to the plans.

items.name: modern-minimal-site
items.title: Modern Minimal Site
items.description: The whole Modern Minimal kit as one launch page for a wake light, one day long: night into morning in a scroll-scrubbed hero, the day through the middle, dusk in the footer, every value bound to the scroll with no easing.

items.name: scrub-mask-reveal
items.title: Scrub Mask Reveal
items.description: A plate that opens exactly with the scroll: its rounded frame widens from a fifth in on each side to full while the picture inside eases the other way so it seems to stay still, bound with no easing, with a hairline that fills.

items.name: wake-time-wheel
items.title: Wake Time Wheel
items.description: Set the alarm on a pair of wheels: hours and minutes are snap-scrolling columns with momentum whose rows turn away in perspective around a lens, each a keyboard spinbutton, with the time the sunrise starts beneath.

items.name: jelly-letter-hero
items.title: Jelly Letter Hero
items.description: A first screen whose oversized headline is made of soft bodies: move through the letters and they dent, press one and it squashes with its area kept, drag it and it stretches after you, let go and it wobbles home.

items.name: puffer-quilt-field
items.title: Puffer Quilt Field
items.description: A background of diamond-quilted puffer you can press: a pillow sinks under your finger while the four around it puff up with the stuffing it lost, then everything springs back, rendered live in WebGL2.

items.name: squash-press-button
items.title: Squash Press Button
items.description: A pill that squashes under your finger and pops back: it sinks onto its base where you press, deeper the longer you hold, keeps its area as it squashes, and springs back with one overshoot while its tinted shadows collapse and return.

items.name: wobble-drop-card
items.title: Wobble Drop Card
items.description: A release card that leans toward the pointer on a soft spring while the sticker on its corner follows through, swinging the other way and jiggling to a stop; press it and the card squashes onto its base and pops back.

items.name: sticker-peel-steps
items.title: Sticker Peel Steps
items.description: How it works as three stickers you peel: pull from a corner and each one curls back around a real fold with its paper liner showing, a shadow growing under the flap; past halfway it comes off and reveals the picture underneath.

items.name: gummy-pile-footer
items.title: Gummy Pile Footer
items.description: A dark footer whose huge wordmark is a pile of gummy letters with weight: grab one and throw it, and it tumbles, bounces off the walls and the other letters, squashes where it lands and settles into a pile.

items.name: squish-letter-heading
items.title: Squish Letter Heading
items.description: A heading whose letters squash under the pointer and push their neighbours up: each letter keeps its area as it squashes, springs back with one overshoot, and the line ripples behind the pointer before settling to crisp type.

items.name: taffy-pill-nav
items.title: Taffy Pill Nav
items.description: A floating pill nav whose bubblegum marker stretches like taffy to the link you choose: long and thin in flight, short and fat as it lands, with the labels turning paper exactly where it covers them.

items.name: fee-squeeze-pricing
items.title: Fee Squeeze Pricing
items.description: Pricing as what you'd pay each month: drag your sales on a slider with a squashy thumb, and every plan's fee springs to its new height as a soft column that stretches thin in flight and squashes as it lands; the cheapest turns bubblegum.

items.name: tactile-maximalism-site
items.title: Tactile Maximalism Site
items.description: The whole Tactile Maximalism kit as one launch page for a creator-commerce platform: a jelly headline, peelable stickers, soft pricing columns, a quilted waitlist and a footer of gummy letters you can throw.

items.name: squish-flip
items.title: Squish Flip
items.description: A list whose items squash and stretch as they move: reorder, filter or add and each item travels to its new place stretched along its path by its speed, squashes as it lands, and settles; new items pop in.

items.name: gummy-type-input
items.title: Gummy Type Input
items.description: An email field whose letters drop in and land: each typed letter falls from a little above, stretched as it falls and squashed as it lands, while the real input underneath keeps the caret, selection and autofill.

items.name: overshoot-lattice-hero
items.title: Overshoot Lattice Hero
items.description: A first screen on a drawn lattice whose caps headline breaks it by rule, and a plate you drag to any free cell: drop it on column 3, 6 or 9 and it overshoots, wears the bracket, and the hairlines bend to make room.

items.name: yielding-hairline-field
items.title: Yielding Hairline Field
items.description: A background that is the lattice itself: twelve-column hairlines with crosses where they meet, bending one gutter around every module the rule breaks and leaning away from the pointer, drawn on a canvas that sleeps when still.

items.name: offset-target-button
items.title: Offset Target Button
items.description: A button whose label plate hangs off its hairline target along the grid's axis, reaches further and lights its bracket on hover or focus, and seats into the target in 120ms when you press it.

items.name: z-swap-plate-card
items.title: Z-Swap Plate Card
items.description: A work card on the lattice: every third in a run breaks by the rule, two gutters out with the bracket, and hovering the card it overlaps lifts that card above it, the bracket going with the lift, in 240ms.

items.name: reflow-states-section
items.title: Reflow States Section
items.description: A pinned section that re-lays four modules into three layouts at scroll checkpoints, all at once in 380ms, and since each layout orders them differently the rule's break passes to the new third, overlapping its left-hand neighbour.

items.name: run-off-wordmark-footer
items.title: Run-off Wordmark Footer
items.description: The closing anchor: the full lattice again, link columns under the rule (the third breaks onto a paper plate with the bracket), and the studio's name fitted to run two gutters past the right edge, whatever the name.

items.name: edge-invert-headline
items.title: Edge Invert Headline
items.description: A caps headline that inverts exactly at the edges of the plates under it; drag a plate and the inversion follows 1:1, then snaps to a lattice cell, and on column 3, 6 or 9 the plate breaks by the rule.

items.name: index-step-nav
items.title: Index Step Nav
items.description: A numbered nav whose third item hangs one gutter below the bar on a contrasting plate by the rule, the bar's hairline dipping under it, and a tag that steps to the current item, or the one you point at, in four ticks.

items.name: third-plate-pricing
items.title: Third Plate Pricing
items.description: Engagements as plates on the lattice: an intro with a Project / Retainer toggle, then three plans; flip the toggle and the plans re-order in 380ms, the prices change, and the rule's break passes to the new third.

items.name: broken-grid-site
items.title: Broken Grid Site
items.description: The whole Broken Grid kit as one studio site on one rule: a drawn-lattice hero, an inverting headline, work and clients that reflow and hand the break on, practices across three layouts, engagements that re-order, and a run-off footer.

items.name: rule-handoff-flip
items.title: Rule Handoff Flip
items.description: The kit's rule for any list: items become plates on the lattice and every third breaks; filter, sort or add and everything moves from where it was in 380ms while the break passes to whichever item is now third.

items.name: hanging-label-input
items.title: Hanging Label Input
items.description: A contact form whose numbered labels hang one gutter off the lattice and step into line in 160ms when you use the field; the third row breaks by the rule, and it only claims to send when it has a handler.

items.name: particle-galaxy-field
items.title: Particle Galaxy Field
items.description: A full-bleed WebGL2 galaxy of up to ten million stars: a hollow ring of lit globes, braided threads and slow-breathing embers that you turn by dragging, while a sweep of the pointer flings stars out of the disk and a spring pulls each one back to its orbit.

items.name: ringed-planet-field
items.title: Ringed Planet Field
items.description: A full-bleed WebGL2 gas giant hanging in black, wearing a ring system of up to ten million particles: a crisp terminator, an accent rim on the lit limb, the rings' shadow across the planet and the planet's shadow across the rings. Drag to orbit, sweep to fling ring particles out of the plane, tap the planet to send a ripple through the rings.

items.name: star-system-section
items.title: Star System Section
items.description: A WebGL2 page section where everything orbits one core: a glass core with a light breathing inside it, and each of your items a planet on its own orbit of braided star dust, with real, keyboard-reachable labels that light the planet, its lane and a detail card.

items.name: keylight-field
items.title: Keylight Field
items.description: A live studio sweep lit by one soft key light, and the light is the theme control: drag it for warmth and exposure, and every Ultra asset on the page retunes while text stays legible.

items.name: aura-dial
items.title: Aura Dial
items.description: A 40px hexagon of the viewer's own six values (contrast, warmth, light, density, motion, focus) that opens into an instrument: pull a corner and every Ultra asset on the page retunes live.

items.name: density-ledger
items.title: Density Ledger
items.description: A list you zoom like a map: pinch, ctrl+scroll, a ruler or [ and ] move rows continuously from 64px to 22px, columns arrive at thresholds, and the row under your pointer stays put.

items.name: patina-dock
items.title: Patina Dock
items.description: A command dock that wears in where it is used: habits animate less, brighten where you press, show their shortcut and move to the front on commit, and a readout says what changed.

items.name: quiet-zone-hero
items.title: Quiet Zone Hero
items.description: A first screen of folded silk that parts around every line you read and holds its contrast under it: no scrim, at any light the reader chooses.
